UMC · Dated operating-assets study / 指定日期经营资产研究

Scope

June 30, 2026 ex-declared-distribution operating-assets-only study using October 19 information. All nonoperating equity investments and circular-ownership benefits are excluded, not valued at zero. This is not total-company fair value, a certified lower bound, a current target or a historical backtest. June capital and FX are fixed: 31.837 TWD per USD; five ordinary shares per ADS.

采用十月十九日信息的 2026 年六月三十日除已宣告分配后的经营资产限定研究。全部非经营股权投资及循环持股利益均排除，并非估值为零。这不是公司整体公允价值、经认证的下限、当前目标价或历史回测。固定六月资本及汇率：每美元 31.837 新台币；每份 ADS 代表五股普通股。

Summary

United Microelectronics is a semiconductor foundry. Ten audited fiscal years and ten completed guidance quarters support these separate bear, base and bull operating scenarios. No scenario probabilities are assigned. Select a complete explicit funding and claims policy before a dated conditional allocation is shown.

联电是一家晶圆代工厂。十个经审计财年及十个已完成指引季度支持独立的熊、基准及牛经营情景。未指定情景概率。明确选择完整资金与请求权政策后才显示指定日期的条件分配。

Growth

First-year revenue of TWD270/300/320bn and subsequent growth are analyst forecasts. The TWD259,541.128m working-capital anchor is twice H1 2026 revenue, not TTM revenue. Ten forecast years end June 30, 2027–2036, not calendar fiscal years. Source monthly revenue extends through September; pending Q3 guidance is not reported results.

首年收入 2700／3000／3200 亿新台币及后续增长属于分析预测。营运资本收入起点 259,541.128 百万新台币是 2026 年上半年收入的两倍，不是滚动十二个月收入。十个预测年度分别截至 2027–2036 年六月三十日，并非日历财年。月度收入来源截至九月；尚未完成的第三季指引不是已报告结果。

Profitability

Edited EBIT margins are pre-lease analyst margins. Total rental-equivalent lease cash is deducted before cash tax; nonlease D&A is added back separately. Recurring SBC stays in operating costs. No investment earnings, related dividends or deferred-grant amortization benefit is added.

编辑的 EBIT 利润率为租赁前分析假设。全部租金等价现金在现金税前扣除；非租赁折旧摊销单独加回。经常性股份薪酬保留在经营成本中。不加入投资收益、相关股息或递延补助摊销利益。

Capital

Net investment equals cash capex minus nonlease D&A plus 25% of the revenue change and selected incremental operating obligations. Editing net investment derives residual cash capex, which must remain nonnegative. Cash capex includes equipment payables and construction/IP commitments; no second deduction or new subsidy is invented. The 25% working-capital ratio is an explicit analyst assumption.

净投资等于现金资本开支减非租赁折旧摊销，加收入变化的 25% 及所选增量经营义务。编辑净投资会推导剩余现金资本开支，必须保持非负。现金开支包含设备应付款及工程／知识产权承诺；不重复扣除或虚构新补助。25% 营运资本比率为明确分析假设。

Funding

Known deposit, dividend, tax, contract, refund and legacy provision claims are reserved once from equity and available cash. Settlements use those reserves and are not charged again in FCFF. All-bank-upfront policy starts TWD489.988009m short; staged bank timing starts TWD10,999.935991m available under its complete assumptions. Annual buckets do not prove daily, jurisdiction-specific or pre-maturity liquidity. No later financing, new deposits or portfolio sales are credited.

已知存款、股息、税款、合同、退款及旧拨备请求权从权益及可用现金各预留一次。结算使用预留款，不再扣减自由现金流。全部银行本金期初预留政策期初缺口为 489.988009 百万新台币；分阶段银行本金政策在全部假设下期初可用 10,999.935991 百万新台币。年度分桶不证明每日、特定地区或到期前流动性。不计入后续融资、新收存款或投资组合出售。

Wacc

Nominal TWD WACC, cash taxes, terminal growth and nonleased-capital ROIC are editable analyst assumptions, not market-calibrated inputs. Discount factors compound the selected annual WACCs. No quoted share price is used to set these assumptions.

名义新台币 WACC、现金税、终值增长及非租赁资本 ROIC 均为可编辑分析假设，未经市场校准。折现因子按所选年度 WACC 复合计算。不使用股票报价设定假设。

Tax

Cash tax is max(0, EBIT after lease cash) times the chosen tax rate. The 20–25% researched rates do not extrapolate H1 headline ETR. No separate DTA cash addback, blanket DTL deduction or portfolio disposal is assumed. Reserved prior-period tax runoff must not reappear in forecast taxes.

现金税等于租赁现金后 EBIT 的非负部分乘所选税率。研究税率 20–25% 不外推上半年表面有效税率。不单独加回递延所得税资产现金、不整体扣除递延所得税负债，也不假设出售投资组合。已预留的前期税款结算不得再次计入预测税款。

Terminal

Terminal FCFF is the lower of lease-normalized NOPAT times (1 − growth / nonleased-capital ROIC) and final-year FCFF times (1 + growth). Terminal lease cash grows with revenue. The exact ten-year horizon and June origin are fixed; automatic capital normalization is unavailable.

终值自由现金流取租赁标准化税后营业利润乘（1 − 增长率／非租赁资本 ROIC）与最后一年自由现金流乘（1 + 增长率）的较低者。终值租赁现金随收入增长。十年期限及六月起点固定；不提供自动资本标准化。

Claims

June ordinary shares outstanding are 12,546.43387m after treasury stock. Existing issued restricted shares are already included. Example policies additionally assume all 67m authorized new shares are issued for no cash; this is an explicit scenario, not a reported issued count. NCI, incremental claims and award reserves remain analyst choices, not certified fair values.

六月扣除库存股后的流通普通股为 12,546.43387 百万股。现有已发行限制性股票已经包含。示例政策另假设全部 6700 万股获授权新股无现金发行；这是明确情景，并非报告的已发行股数。少数股权、增量请求权及奖励预留仍为分析选择，非经认证公允价值。

Awards

The 67m authorization is not an observed issuance. Keeping recurring SBC expense and assuming additional authorized dilution is conservative and can overlap compensation cost; it is not an award-level fair-value allocation. Circular cross-holding denominator reductions and nonzero portfolio addbacks require a separately reviewed model and are rejected here.

6700 万股授权不是已观察到的发行。保留经常性股份薪酬费用并假设额外授权稀释较为保守，可能重叠薪酬成本；并非逐项奖励公允价值分配。循环持股分母扣减及非零投资组合加回需要独立复核模型，本模型拒绝。

History

FY2016–2025 original-as-filed history remains beside assumptions, with separately retained latest comparatives and field-level source locators. IFRS9/15 in 2018, IFRS16 in 2019, the 2019 USJC acquisition and 2022 IAS37 limit comparisons. The 2021 deposit reclassification and 2016 prepayment presentation are explicitly reconciled. Historical total D&A includes ROU after IFRS16 and is not forecast nonlease D&A. CFO less capex is not unlevered FCFF.

2016–2025 财年原始申报历史置于假设旁，并单独保留最新比较数及字段级来源定位。2018 年 IFRS9／15、2019 年 IFRS16、2019 年 USJC 收购及 2022 年 IAS37 限制可比性。2021 年存款重分类与 2016 年预付款列报已明确核对。IFRS16 后历史总折旧摊销包含使用权资产，并非预测非租赁折旧摊销。经营现金流减资本开支不等于无杠杆自由现金流。

Guidance

Ten completed guidance quarters contain 50 metric-period comparisons against original issuer ranges and subsequent results. Approximate and qualitative guidance remain qualified. Pending Q3 2026 guidance, annual capex and monthly sales are separately labeled; analyst consensus is not substituted.

十个已完成指引季度包含 50 项指标期间比较，使用公司原始区间及后续结果。约数及定性指引保留限定。尚未完成的 2026 年第三季指引、全年资本开支及月度销售单独标示；不替换为分析师共识。

Uncertainty

No calibrated Monte Carlo distribution is supplied. Manual simulation starts with fixed settings and varies only edited operating assumptions. It retains lease normalization and the terminal cap, but exposes operating EV only, never an ADS or current-target distribution. Claims and funding assumptions stay fixed; simulated EV does not prove funding feasibility.

未提供校准蒙特卡洛分布。手动模拟以固定设置开始，仅改变编辑的经营假设。保留租赁标准化及终值上限，只显示经营企业价值，不显示 ADS 或当前目标价分布。请求权与资金假设固定；模拟企业价值不证明资金可行性。
